facility.name: His Kidz Academy

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 8023 HUEBNER RD, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78240

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Five of the seven staff files reviewed did not have current certification in CPR/First aid available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: One of the seven staff files reviewed had a CPR/First aid certificate from an exclusively online source. There was no hands-on training for the CPR portion of these courses.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver left a group of three children unattended to open the front door for CCR inspectors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: One of the ten children's files reviewed did not include Name, address, and telephone number of the child?s physician or an emergency-care facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Signed Admission Form: Five of the ten admission records reviewed did not include parent signatures on the admission paperwork.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Signed Admission Form (26 TAC §746.607)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The last fire inspection conducted was dated 4/30/2024. The operation has not had an fire inspection condcuted in the last 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: During an inspection, a classroom was observed having breakfast and watching Bluey.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person: The investigation revealed that there is no established protocol for recording the identities of individuals authorized for pickup, when staff reported that copies of IDs are not made and maintained in children's files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person (26 TAC §746.4103(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employees Supervised: Through an investigation, it was determined that director's responsibilities were not met when the director did not relay the information about a child's health and medication needs the caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Supervised (26 TAC §746.1003(4))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One staff member did not have training in pediatric first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Two children's files reviewed did not have parent signed medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Three caregivers did not have training certificates available for review in required training topics; emergency preparedness, administering medication, preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction, communicable diseases, understanding building and physical premises, and hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two children were missing necessary information for their emergency contacts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required: Five staff members were missing training hours in required topics such as; child growth and development, guidance and discipline, age-appropriate curriculum, and teacher-child interaction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required (26 TAC §746.1309(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: One file did not have necessary phyician information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: One child's file reviewed did not have listed release information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §746.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: One required staff member did not have current training hours in transportation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Two classrooms, that are licensed space, were being used as storage areas.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three children's files did not have a health statement available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: One staff member was missing training hours in that focus on the preventions, recognition, and reporting of child maltreatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Four of the six staff files reviewed did not have the 24 required hours of training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: The operational polcies did include information for supporting inclusive services for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation had not completed a fire drill in the 2024 year. Noted: a fire drill was conducted during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational polcies/parent handbook did not include information for the promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An individual without a background check was able to drive the transportation van to pick up school-aged children.   Noted: this was corrected when the individual was removed from the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee conduct walk-through and visual check of vehicle: A van driver did not conduct a walkthrough of the van,  ensuring that all children had exited the vehicle, before leaving the van unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee conduct walk-through and visual check of vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(d)(2))

occurrences.finding: Director Certificate Not Renewed: Director credentials expired and updates credentials were not submitted timely.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Certificate Not Renewed (26 TAC §746.1057)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: During the investigation process, it was determined that caregivers were not using proper discipline, by yelling at the children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: The handwashing sink was observed to be used to wash dishes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Cover All Stored Food: Through the investigation process it was determined that the operation was not storing food appropriately by storing baby food refrigerator uncovered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Cover All Stored Food (26 TAC §746.3317(8))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Single Use Items if Cannot Sanitize: Food service equipment, such as bowls utensils and bottles, are not being sanitized.   Noted, that these items are being cleaned with dish soap and water.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Single Use Items if Cannot Sanitize (26 TAC §746.3317(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: During the investigation process, it was determined that during feeding times, infant's bottles were being propped with a rolled towel of blanket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: One of the staff members have CPR/First aid training that was completed online.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Five of the ten staff files reveiwed did not have the required 24 hours of training for the most recently completed training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: A staff member qqo is required to have 30 hours of training did not have this in the most recent completed training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two of the ten children's files reviewed did not have current immunization records in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Immunizations-Docs may be official record or copy that have signature of health care prof. or name of other prof who administered vaccine: One of the ten children's files reviewed did not include an official imunization record with the physician's signature.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunizations-Docs may be official record or copy that have signature of health care prof. or name of other prof who administered vaccine (26 TAC §746.623(2)(D))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: One caregiver who cares for children 24 months and younger did not have training in the required topics; SIDS and shaken baby.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: Form 2885 Children's Product Certification was last signed 12/6/2021.   Noted: This was corrected during the inspection when CPSC website was reviewed and Form 2885 was signed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver used poor judgement when she gave a supplement to children without the knowledge or consent of the children's parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children: Through an investigation it was found that caregivers were not implementing the operation's policy to verify authorized individuals for pick up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4103(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child with a diagnosed food allergy did not have a food allergy emergency plan included in her file.     Recite: the food allergy plan requested has not been submitted to CCR staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Three of the 11 children's files viewed did not have updated shot records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child with a diagnosed food allergies did not have a food allergy emergency plan included in her file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Two individuals required to have training in transportation did not have a certificate verifying the number of hours and completion.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: Two classrooms were observed to be watching a movie during their breakfast time.  Noted: this was corrected at inspection when caregivers were made aware of the standard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: The first aid kit utilized in the vans were missing cotton balls and tweezers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The transportation binder utilized by van drivers did not include the children's Emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: Two of the operations transportation vehicles was not equipped with the child safety alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: There were nine out of seventeen staff files reviewed that were missing CPR/1st Aid certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Five out of seventeen staff were missing annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: Drill logs were not current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: A staff member that transports children did not have transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: I observed a 12 month old infant in a play yard, drinking a bottle before naptime.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver removed the bottle from the play yard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: During a DFPS investigation, the investigator heard a caregiver yelling a children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The operation was not administered with compliance with Minimum Standard Rules when the director allowed classrooms to operate out of ratio for multiple days.,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: During the investigation, it was determined that supervision was not appropriate when a child was bitten multiple times during diaper changing times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training: Upon review of training hours, one caregiver did not have 23 hours of the required 24 hours of training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: It's was determined during the course of the investigation, the two yr old classroom was out of ratio when one caregiver had 18-22 children on several occasions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Enough Available to Prevent Competition: Multiple classrooms were observed with limited toys/activities accessible to children to be involved with.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Enough Available to Prevent Competition (26 TAC §746.2505(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: A sleeping infant was observed in a crib laying on a loosely fitted sheet.    This was corrected at inspection when the sheet was replaced with a snugly fitted one.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: A single caregiver was observed in hallway overseeing 19 children with a specified age group of 4 years.  The allowed ratio for this age group is 18 children per caregiver.      This was corrected at inspection when another caregiver joined to assist in overseeing children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Out of 8 personnel records observed, 2 remained incomplete.  1 file is missing employee acknowledgment statements for receipt of operation and personnel policies;this file is also missing orientation statement for A/N training   and employee affidavit.  Another file is missing both statement acknowledging receipt of policies, A/N training, employment qualifications, employment affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Two infants were observed sleeping in cribs unsupervised while the caregiver tended to other2 infants on floor.  The caregivers direct line of sight is blocked by half wall division in middle of room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: I observed an unqualified person with direct care of transporting children who did not have an eligible  background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: I observed six infants present with one caregiver when the specified age group for 12 -17 months is five infants to one caregiver.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when ratio was met by moving the youngest infant to the younger infant classroom.     I observed 27 children to one caregiver when the other caregiver left the classroom.  The child/caregiver ratio for the specified age group for 3 year old's 30:2.  The classroom was over ratio by 12 children.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver returned to the classroom.    I observed 17 children to one caregiver when the other caregiver was also the person in charge and not in the classroom.  The specified age group for 2 year olds is 11 children to one caregiver.  The classroom was over ratio by 5 children.      Note: This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver returned to the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: I observed a child in the hallway unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: I observed the two year old classroom and four year old classroom very dark with soft music playing on a T.V. Screen, unable to identify or locate the children in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: During naptime, I observed 23 children present with 1 caregiver. The specified age group was 2 years, and the child/caregiver ratio is 22:1 at naptime.  The classroom was over ratio by 1 child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: I observed a outlet cover missing in the toddler classroom that was accessible to children.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver covered the electrical outlet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation's annual fire inspection was not completed timely. The last fire inspection was conducted on 11/10/2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: I observed 10 personnel records that were incomplete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: A background check for a seven people no longer employed at the operation was not inactivated within seven days.    Note: This was corrected at inspection as the background check for seven people was inactivated during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))
